Summary
: This essay studies the Bhagavatpadabhyudaya by Lakshmana Suri: a renowned Sanskrit Scholar from the 19th century who wrote several works. The Bhagavatpada-abhyudaya is a Mahakavya (epic poem) narrating the life of Shankara-Acharya. This essay investigates the socio-spiritual conditions of 8th century AD as reflected in Lakshmanasuri’s work. It also deals with the various philosophical topics found in Advaita Vedanta, such as Brahman (the Supreme Reality), Jiva (the Individual Soul) and Jagat (the Universe).
Alternative titles: Bhagavatpādābhyudaya (भगवत्पादाभ्युदय) Bhagavatpādābyudaya (भगवत्पादाब्युदय ), Lakṣmaṇasūrin (लक्ष्मणसूरिन्, Lakshmanasurin, Surin) Lakṣmaṇasūrī (लक्ष्मणसूरी)
